summary: Expose bounded indexed ticket discovery through Store and API

delivery.outcome: Continue PLF-20292 by exposing bounded, strictly current indexed identity/queue discovery through the public Planfile Store/Python and HTTP API, without decoding or counting historical payloads. Publish independently and qualify installed Native before declaring delivery.
nonGoals: No execution admission/claim or dependency promotion; discovery only.
No physical active/history migration, source rewrites, lock deletion, global page-cap increase, unrelated release/version edits or publication-policy changes.

architecture.decision: Expose one bounded discovery page contract for exact repository/issue or exact queue/state. Reuse indexed primitives, use summary projection by default, preserve one SQLite read transaction per page, and bind cursors to normalized query and current source generation. Reject stale/unavailable projection without foreground rebuild, full archive fallback or COUNT. A positive discovery result grants no execution authority.
interfaceChanges: Public Planfile/Store discovery page contract with opaque generation/query-bound keyset cursors.
GET /tickets/discovery query endpoint registered before the ticket-ID route.
Backward-compatible optional summary projection on the indexed routing primitives.
architecture.rollback: Revert material source through independent publication; retain all canonical YAML/evidence and existing disposable index. Any Native replacement requires a fresh exact-target operator plan.

validation.evidence: SDK/API parity, repository isolation, explicit terminal/history lookup, retry/wait discovery, bounded materialization/no COUNT or archive loading; continuation pagination.
Changed-generation and cross-query cursors reject; stale/disabled/contended index returns explicit retryable refusal without rebuilding; concurrent index reads retain one coherent page.

commands: protected OneDev exact-head/current-base verification and independent Validator publication
isolated installed-package discovery qualification, then freshly fenced Native rollout
validation.evidence: Independent source merge and immutable artifact/Native readback are distinct; preserve canonical records, peers and automation.
